nodes.speaker: eng
nodes.text: The heat shield will face 1,300 degrees Celsius soon. Should we inspect it with the hull camera?

variants.text: That launch damage worries me. The heat shield is right behind that spot. Inspect it?
The heat shield will face 1,300 degrees Celsius. We packed spares, so we can fix things. Inspect it?

nodes.fact: Perseverance's heat shield reached about 1,300 degrees Celsius. It burns away on purpose to carry heat off.

nodes.speaker: eng
nodes.text: The camera shows a hairline crack in the backshell, right where the launch damage was.

variants.text: The camera shows a hairline crack in the backshell. We have the spare plates to fix it.

nodes.fact: Capsules have a heat shield on the front and a backshell on the back. Both protect the crew.
